deposit-field-exceptions: WITH S AS (SELECT M.CVE_CLIE,M.NO_FACTURA,COUNT(*) AS CHARGES,SUM(M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO) AS TOTAL,SUM(CASE WHEN M.NUM_CARGO=0 THEN M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO ELSE 0 END) AS ZERO_AMOUNT,MIN(CASE WHEN M.NUM_CARGO=1 THEN M.IMPORTE ELSE NULL END) AS FIRST_AMOUNT FROM CUEN_M15 M WHERE M.NUM_CPTO=18 GROUP BY M.CVE_CLIE,M.NO_FACTURA) SELECT F.CVE_DOC,F.IMPORTE,F.PRIMERPAGO,F.NUM_PAGOS,S.CHARGES,S.ZERO_AMOUNT,S.FIRST_AMOUNT FROM S JOIN FACTF15 F ON F.CVE_DOC=S.NO_FACTURA AND F.CVE_CLPV=S.CVE_CLIE WHERE F.STATUS<>'C' AND ABS(S.ZERO_AMOUNT-COALESCE(F.PRIMERPAGO,0))>0.01
